sentences.text:
Applicant :- Sher Alam
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Pradeep Kumar
Hon'ble Nalin Kumar Srivastava,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
2.

The present transfer application has been moved by the applicant under Section 407 Cr.P.C.
seeking transfer of case crime no. 131 of 2019 under Section 420, 406 I.P.C. Police Station- Dildarnagar, District- Ghazipur from the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ghazipur to the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Maharajganj or nearest district like Gorakhpur for proper adjudication of the case.

entities.text: I.P.C. Police Station- Dildarnagar, District- Ghazipur
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that in this case good sense was prevailed between both the parties and they entered into a compromise to settle their dispute and in view of that an application U/S 482 Cr.P.C No. 16343 of 2024 filed by the present applicant was decided by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 31.5.2024 directing therein both the parties to appear before the Court concerned along with an application for verification of compromise deed,
however, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the parties are facing some problems Sher Alam vs State Of U.P. And Another on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168319960/
1 in the district Ghazipur as some of the persons relating to opposite party no.2 are creating hindrance in the compromise proceedings and on these grounds prayer for transfer of the said case has been made.

entities.text: Sher Alam vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel appearing for opposite party no.2 has submitted that he has no objection if the case is decided in terms of compromise before the competent Court at Ghazipur.
5. I have considered the rival submissions made by the learned counsel for the parties and have gone through the entire record carefully.

6. In the facts and circumstances, particularly keeping in view the specific direction passed by this Court in an Application U/S 482 Cr.P.C. as mentioned herein above to both the parties to appear before the Court concerned i.e. the Court at Ghazipur, in my view the present transfer application is having no force and it is liable to be rejected.
7.
Hence, the present transfer application is rejected.
